title: EnergySystems LoadForecastCSV

stats.done_summary: Successfully completed the Power Systems Load Forecasting and Reliability Analysis task. Analyzed 15-minute interval load data (672 observations over 7 days) from load_15min.csv. Generated comprehensive analysis including: (1) Load pattern characterization with hourly and daily patterns, (2) Peak demand analysis (135.35 MW peak, 88.6% load factor), (3) 7-day load forecast with confidence intervals, (4) Annual energy projection (1,050.47 GWh), (5) Reliability assessment with capacity requirements (171.21 MW for 15% reserve margin). Created 7 publication-quality figures and 5 output data files. Delivered complete report at report/report.md with methodology, results, discussion, and recommendations for the operations review.
